audits.mathematicalReason: All digits are nonzero because they strictly increase from a nonzero leading digit. Five digits would have square sum at least 1²+2²+3²+4²+5²=55, so there are at most four digits. For four digits, a first digit at least 2 would give a minimum square sum of 54, and a second digit at least 3 would give at least 51. Thus the first two digits are 1 and 2. The third can only be 3 or 4; 4 leaves a nonsquare remainder 29, while 3 leaves 36, giving the final digit 6. Hence 1236 is the unique four-digit possibility and exceeds every shorter one. Its digit product is 36.
